entities.name: Idle/Inactive Measurement Configuration Update
entities.description: Procedure to update the idle/inactive measurement configuration for UE measurements in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE states.

entities.name: T331
entities.description: Timer that must be running for the measurement configuration update procedure to initiate.

entities.name: T319a
entities.description: Timer that must not be running for the measurement configuration update procedure to initiate.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE performs idle measurements.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE performs inactive measurements.

entities.name: VarMeasIdleConfig
entities.description: Variable storing the UE's idle/inactive measurement configuration.

entities.name: measIdleCarrierListEUTRA
entities.description: List of E-UTRA carriers for idle/inactive measurements.

entities.name: measIdleCarrierListNR
entities.description: List of NR carriers for idle/inactive measurements.

entities.name: ssb-MeasConfig
entities.description: SSB measurement configuration for NR carriers.

entities.name: Cell selection condition
entities.description: Condition met when UE selects a cell upon entering RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE from RRC_CONNECTED or RRC_INACTIVE.

entities.name: System information update condition
entities.description: Condition met upon update of system information (SIB4 or SIB11) due to intra-RAT cell (re)selection.

entities.name: Store EUTRA carrier list
entities.description: UE stores or replaces measIdleCarrierListEUTRA from SIB11 in VarMeasIdleConfig.

entities.name: Remove EUTRA carrier list
entities.description: UE removes measIdleCarrierListEUTRA from VarMeasIdleConfig if stored.

entities.name: Store NR carrier list
entities.description: UE stores or replaces measIdleCarrierListNR from SIB11 in VarMeasIdleConfig.

entities.name: Remove NR carrier list
entities.description: UE removes measIdleCarrierListNR from VarMeasIdleConfig if stored.

relations.description: Procedure requires T331 timer to be running.
Procedure requires T319a timer to not be running.
Procedure initiation is guarded by cell selection condition.
Procedure initiation is guarded by system information update condition.
Procedure operates on VarMeasIdleConfig information element.
Cell selection condition may lead to storing EUTRA carrier list.
System information update condition may lead to storing NR carrier list.
Procedure is performed in RRC_IDLE state.
Procedure is performed in RRC_INACTIVE state.
